controls.label: Shape model
controls.description: A smooth ellipsoid based on the 102 × 92 × 72 km semi-axes measured from Voyager images by Karkoschka (2003). The available images are strongly smeared and do not support a registered surface map. The standard gray grid marks missing imagery; shared lighting shows the model shape. No craters or local elevation are invented.
controls.title: Approximate shape model
controls.summary: Shape estimated from blurred Voyager images. Local terrain is unresolved; gray grid: no mapped imagery.
